# Nathan Santos

> Product Engineer building full-stack products with NestJS, Next.js, and PostgreSQL. Currently shipping at OMD do Brasil and building SaaS on the side. Based in Sertãozinho, SP, Brazil.

## About

Nathan Santos is a Product Engineer who works across the full stack in the TypeScript ecosystem (Next.js, React, Node.js, NestJS, Supabase, PostgreSQL). He takes products from zero to production, with a focus on performance, clean architecture, and developer experience.

- [Home](https://www.nathannfs.com/): Overview, selected work, expertise, and tech stack.
- [About](https://www.nathannfs.com/about): Background, education, certifications, and experience.
- [Projects](https://www.nathannfs.com/projects): Full list of shipped products and case studies.

## Selected work

- OMD Farm ERP: Enterprise ERP for inventory, finance, production, and supply chain. NestJS, Prisma, Angular, MQTT, Redis.
- Precifica Agora: Marketplace-intelligence SaaS with an automated pricing engine on the Mercado Livre API. Next.js, Supabase, TanStack Query.
- Inventory Predictor: Multi-tenant inventory forecasting with Shopify OAuth and Stripe billing. Next.js, PostgreSQL.
- Checkout Hub: Webhook-routing infrastructure for user provisioning across Supabase instances after Stripe payments. Node.js, Hono.
